envelope.description: Pin the v2 launch policy and native evidence contract

body.title: Pin the v2 launch policy and native evidence contract
body.summary: Extend the shared Claude restricted/control templates and strict typed v2 boundary/protocol/basis fields. Turn actual 2.1.310 startup diagnostic captures into exact-version inventory/source-policy parsing and negative fixtures; keep old v1/Codex/design behavior. Demonstrate required managed/source facts early so implementation cannot conceal an unsupported qualification contract.
acceptanceChecks: Session-local policy disables unwanted builtin plugins, hooks, instruction discovery and memory, retains OAuth and exact scoped bridge; no safe-mode/bare/bypass or global config changes.
Exact schema-bound StructuredOutput is explicitly a protocol tool; unknown, duplicate, malformed or contradictory native tools/plugins/sources refuse.
Native no-managed/organization/source grammar is based on the real feasibility capture; missing, unsupported, remote or conflicting managed evidence cannot qualify.
Strict v2 fields/basis enums are required only for v2; old formats cannot mint v2 proof.

Native diagnostic capture is private, bounded, hashed and redacted before user-facing summaries; no secrets/model assertions become proof. Strict evidence schema/type/qualification consumers match v2.

tests.name: Claude v2 launch disables plugins hooks instructions and memory without breaking OAuth or scoped MCP
StructuredOutput is schema-bound protocol only and every unknown duplicate malformed or contradictory native capability refuses
Missing or managed policy provenance cannot become an empty effective inventory
